intro: Nothing on this page has been implemented except where marked 'Built'. Each item lists options. Choose one per item before anything changes. 'Lean' is a suggestion, not a decision.

suggestions.topic: Where click and conversion events are recorded
suggestions.why: The brief needs click measurement before anything else. GitHub Pages cannot store events (F-09).

options.label: Serverless endpoint (e.g., a small Cloudflare Worker) that stores event counts only
options.pros: Free tier likely enough at small scale; no visitor IDs needed.
options.cons: Needs a Cloudflare account and a deploy step.

options.label: Self-hosted privacy analytics (e.g., Umami or Plausible) on a small server
options.pros: Full control; no third-party data sharing.

options.label: Hosted privacy-focused analytics service
options.cons: Vendor choice and data terms need review.

options.label: Defer; use Associates reports only
options.cons: No per-page or per-guide signal; slower to learn.

suggestions.lean: A or B, once the owner accepts a small hosting cost. Verify the chosen vendor's privacy terms before turning it on.

suggestions.topic: How outbound product links are formed
suggestions.why: Compliance and tracking depend on link format (F-02, F-04).

options.label: Keep the supplied short links, marked rel="sponsored" (current build)

options.cons: Status unresolved; may be disqualified (F-04); token/destination mismatch (F-02).

options.label: Replace with canonical /dp/ASIN links carrying the tracking ID, after the ASIN is confirmed
options.cons: Needs confirmed ASINs; the tag must be applied correctly.

options.label: Generate Special Links per product in the Associates Link Builder, after the one-link test passes
options.cons: Manual step in the Associates account.

suggestions.lean: C after the one-link-per-product test (F-05). Until then, keep A and show nothing as confirmed.
